notes.title: September 18th, 2025 Development Update
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216946/49542a2c2c44fe67e3a4630b11544709d146a04a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Development of [b]Sim Update 4[/b] for [i]Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024[/i] continues. Earlier today, we released a new pre-release build (1.6.7.0) to those players participating in the ongoing public beta test. You can read the release notes at the link below. If you would like to join the beta, you can find instructions for all platforms (PC-MS Store, PC-Steam, and Xbox Series X|S) [u][url="https://forums.flightsimulator.com/t/read-first-welcome-to-the-sim-update-4-beta/591232"]here[/url][/u].[/p][list][*][p][u][url="https://forums.flightsimulator.com/t/sim-update-4-beta-1-6-7-0-release-notes-september-18-2025/738692"]Sim Update 4 Beta (1.6.7.0) Release Notes – September 18, 2025[/url][/u][/p][/*][/list][p]As always, we encourage everyone participating in the beta to vote in [u][url="https://forums.flightsimulator.com/c/su4/su3-surveys/391"]our forum surveys[/url][/u]. Your bug reports and other feedback are incredibly valuable to us as the team works to refine SU4 and make it the best it can be.[/p][p]Whether you are enrolled in the SU4 beta or not, if you would like to help the developers improve the [b]text and voiceover quality[/b] in MSFS 2024’s Career Mode, we are currently hosting a web survey in which you can submit feedback about this aspect of the sim. We appreciate everyone who takes a few minutes to [u][url="https://forms.office.com/pages/responsepage.aspx?id=v4j5cvGGr0GRqy180BHbR0PL3srS16VArVQZXYbiYeVUMFJLOE9NNjM2UjlOUzY0VEZSWklORUs1My4u&route=shorturl"]complete the survey at this link[/url][/u]! In particular, we would especially value feedback about languages other than English.[/p][p]Finally, earlier this week there was a temporary outage with the live weather service that impacted both [i]Microsoft Flight Simulator (2020)[/i] and [i]Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024.[/i] This issue has since been resolved, and live weather in both sims is once again functioning normally. Thank you for your patience and understanding as our teams worked to fix the issue.[/p][p][i]– MSFS Team[/i]
[/p][hr][/hr][p][url="https://www.flightsimulator.com/september-18th-2025-development-update/"]Click here to continue reading the Development Update![/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: September 11th, 2025 Development Update
notes.content:
[p]The [i]Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024[/i] [b]Sim Update 4[/b] pre-release public beta test began earlier this week! So far, two test builds have been released to volunteer testers from the community. You can read the release notes for each of these builds on our forums here:[/p][list][*][p][url="https://forums.flightsimulator.com/t/sim-update-4-beta-1-6-3-0-release-notes-september-8th-2025/737331"]SU4 Beta 1.6.3.0 - September 8, 2025[/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://forums.flightsimulator.com/t/sim-update-4-beta-1-6-5-0-release-notes-september-10th-2025/737557"]SU4 Beta 1.6.5.0 - September 10, 2025[/url][/p][/*][/list][p]Also this week, we announced the [url="https://www.flightsimulator.com/top-rated-scenery-landmark-sale/"]Top-Rated Scenery & Landmark Sale[/url]! Between now and September 16, enjoy savings of up to 60% on many of the most highly-rated scenery and landmark add-on products as voted by the community.[/p][p]Finally, the [url="https://airrace.org/"]National Championship Air Races[/url] kicked off yesterday for their inaugural year at their new home in Roswell, New Mexico. To everyone in our September Family, the Microsoft Flight Simulator team wishes all of you a week filled with thrilling races, excitement, fun, and friendship![/p][p][i]- MSFS Team[/i]

notes.title: Sim Update 4 Beta Now Available to Join
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216946/ee9ea71fd2193f504ff5e486a6928474d991d4e0.png"][/img][/p][p]
[b]Welcome to the [i]Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024[/i] Sim Update 4 public beta test![/b][/p][p]The Sim Update 04 Beta is now available on Steam, Windows PC, and Xbox.[/p][p]The release notes for the first SU4 test build (1.6.3.0) can be found [u][url="https://forums.flightsimulator.com/t/sim-update-4-beta-1-6-3-0-release-notes-september-8th-2025/737331"]on our forums here[/url][/u].[/p][p][/p][h1][b]Changes to Career/Challenge League[/b][/h1][p]Just like the recent Sim Update 3 Beta, Career and Challenge League will have separate progress and leaderboards from the live build.[/p][p]This means Career mode progress in the live build will not carry over to the flighting build, and vice versa. In addition, Challenge League in the flighting build will have a separate leaderboard from the live build.[/p][p]Making Career and Challenge League progress separate in the flighting build allows us to test additional changes and fixes that cannot be tested in the live build. All Career specializations will be unlocked by default in the flighting build to allow participants to preview changes that might not be available (based on Career mode progress) in the live build.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Will joining the Sim Update 4 Beta (and future Sim Update Betas) impact my progress in Career mode on the live build?[/b][/p][list][*][p]No, Career mode progress is locked to the live build. No Career progress made in the flighting build will carry over to the live build. However, all Career mode specializations are unlocked by default in the flighting build.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Will my leaderboard records in Challenge League transfer when the flighting build becomes the live build?[/b][/p][list][*][p]No, Challenge League leaderboards in the flighting build will always be separate from the live build.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Will progress in other game modes (Discovery, Free Flight, etc.) be separate in the flighting build and live build?[/b][/p][list][*][p]No, only progress in Career and Challenge League are affected. This could change in the future.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Will content I own or purchase in the Marketplace be available on both the flighting build and the live build?[/b][/p][list][*][p]Yes, all content owned or purchased in the live build or the flighting build will always be available in both builds.[/p][/*][/list][p]Please find instructions to join the Sim Update 04 Beta below. You must own Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 (or have an appropriate Xbox Game Pass subscription) to participate on the platform of your choice.[/p][p][/p][h1][b]What to Know Before You Join[/b][/h1][p][b]MS Store PC Users:[/b] There is always a risk that you may have to re-install the sim when joining/leaving a flight, so please keep this in mind before participating.[/p][p]If you have MSFS content installed completely on a custom path, you will have a much lower chance that a full re-install will be necessary when the update is officially released. However, if your sim content is installed in the default path selected by the in-game content manager, you may have to reinstall the whole sim when moving from the test build to the public build. We recommend that those who wish to test with us ensure your sim content is located in a custom path before joining the flight to avoid full reinstallations in the future (Details on how to do this can be found [u][url="https://forums.flightsimulator.com/t/how-to-change-the-installation-path-of-installed-packages-inc-community-folder/471682"]here[/url][/u]). The best set up would be for your store app to live on the default C: drive and sim content on a custom drive.[/p][p]Please remember if you decide to join the Beta and install the build, you will likely have to re-install your sim if you wish to leave the Beta before it ends. If you did not opt out of the last Beta, you will automatically stay in this Beta and receive the next build.[/p][p]In addition, while in Multiplayer Mode, you will only see users who are in the same build as you.[/p][h1][/h1][h1][b]How to Join or Leave the Beta on Steam[/b][/h1][olist][*][p]Open your Steam Library[/p][/*][*][p]Right-click Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024[/p][/*][*][p]Click “Properties”[/p][/*][*][p]Click “Betas”[/p][/*][*][p]Select “flight_sim_beta – Sim Update 4″[/p][/*][/olist][p]If you would like to exit the pre-release test before it ends and revert back to the live build, follow these instructions:[/p][olist][*][p]Open your Steam Library[/p][/*][*][p]Right-click Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024[/p][/*][*][p]Click “Properties”[/p][/*][*][p]Click “Betas”[/p][/*][*][p]Select “None”[/p][/*][/olist][h1][b]Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 Insider Program FAQ:[/b][/h1][p][b]Why transition to the website sign-up for flighting?[/b][/p][p]Moving forward, leveraging the website will allow us to send direct communication to participants who have opted-in (such as when a new flighting opportunity is available), create bespoke flighting audiences (such as specific groups focused on VR, accessibility, performance, etc.), and create private forums accessible to specific flighting participants. These tools will help us gather better feedback and reach more participants in the future.[/p][p][b]I’m already participating in flighting for Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024, do I need to do anything?[/b][/p][p]Steam users are unaffected by these changes, and the flight_sim_2024_beta branch will remain accessible to all flighting participants on Steam.[/p][p]We would still encourage all current participants to complete the website sign-up (including those participating on Steam), but it is not required at this time.[/p]

As always, please monitor [u][url="https://forums.flightsimulator.com/"]our official forums[/url][/u] to find instructions on how to join the beta and read its patch notes once it’s available. Alternatively, you can also follow us on your preferred social network (all linked below) for the latest MSFS news.[/p][list][*][p][u][url="https://bsky.app/profile/msfsofficial.bsky.social"]Bluesky[/url][/u][/p][/*][*][p][u][url="https://www.facebook.com/MSFSofficial"]Facebook[/url][/u][/p][/*][*][p][u][url="https://www.threads.com/@msfsofficial"]Threads[/url][/u][/p][/*][*][p][u][url="https://x.com/MSFSofficial"]X (formerly Twitter)[/url][/u][/p][/*][/list][p]Also, as a friendly reminder, if you require 1:1 tech support for either [i]Microsoft Flight Simulator (2020) [/i]or [i]Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024[/i], you can submit a support ticket on [u][url="https://flightsimulator.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/requests/new"]our Zendesk portal here[/url][/u]. The Zendesk page also includes [u][url="https://flightsimulator.zendesk.com/hc/en-us"]an FAQ section[/url][/u] with step-by-step instructions to resolve some of the most common issues players have with each sim.[/p][p][i]– MSFS Team[/i]

notes.title: August 28th, 2025 Development Update
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216946/345ed89fe7b1d4492bd5bbaec051cee970f499c1.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Last week we released [b]Sim Update 3[/b] for [i]Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024[/i]. In case you missed it, the full release notes for SU3 are available [u][url="https://www.flightsimulator.com/sim-update-3-msfs-2024/"]at this link[/url][/u]. Also, if you have not yet done so, please be sure to vote in our SU3 surveys [u][url="https://forums.flightsimulator.com/t/polls-microsoft-flight-simulator-2024-sim-update-3-feedback/734491"]on our forums here[/url][/u]. notes.title: August 21st, 2025 Development Update
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216946/12332ae4f2667f530afd8f26a1f07b965b2daa7e.jpg"][/img][/p][p]This was a big week for new releases for MSFS fans![/p][p]First, we released [b]Sim Update 3[/b] (version 1.5.27.0) for [i]Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024.[/i] This update contains thousands of bug fixes and other improvements, as well as the ability to download more content to one's local storage drive, a feature that was highly requested from the community. You can read the full release notes for SU3 [url="https://www.flightsimulator.com/sim-update-3-msfs-2024/"]at this link[/url]. Please be sure to vote in our SU3 surveys and leave feedback for the developers [url="https://forums.flightsimulator.com/t/polls-microsoft-flight-simulator-2024-sim-update-3-feedback/734491"]on our forums here[/url].[/p][p]We followed up the release of Sim Update 3 with [b]City Update 12[/b] and [b]Local Legend 21[/b]! CU12 enhances six cities in Germany: Augsburg, Bremen, Dresden, Leuben, Leipzig, Kiel, and Münster. [url="https://www.flightsimulator.com/city-update-12/"]You can read more about this update here[/url]. As with all City Updates and World Updates, you can claim it for [b]FREE[/b] from the in-sim Marketplace for both [i]Microsoft Flight Simulator (2020)[/i] and [i]Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024.[/i][/p][p]Local Legend 21 is the [b]Eurocopter EC135[/b], one of the world's most advanced light utility helicopters! This is the fourth and final "make good" aircraft granted [b]FREE[/b] to all MSFS 2024 players as our way of thanking you for your patience with the issues encountered during last November's launch. [url="https://www.flightsimulator.com/local-legend-21/"]You can read more about the EC135 here[/url].[/p][p][i]- MSFS Team[/i]
[/p][hr][/hr][p][url="https://www.flightsimulator.com/august-21st-2025…velopment-update/"]Click here to continue reading the Development Update![/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: August 14th, 2025 Development Update
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216946/93cc7843650b6c7865fc657331008c0077e313a4.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The ongoing beta test for MSFS 2024 [b]Sim Update 3 [/b]continues with two new pre-release builds this week. In case you missed it, you can see the release notes for each of these test builds here:[/p][list][*][p][u][url="https://forums.flightsimulator.com/t/sim-update-3-beta-1-5-24-0-release-notes-august-11-2025/732848"]Sim Update 3 Beta (1.5.24.0) Release Notes – August 11th, 2025[/url][/u][/p][list][*][p][u][url="https://forums.flightsimulator.com/t/sim-update-3-beta-1-5-25-0-release-notes-august-13-2025/733520"]Sim Update 3 Beta (1.5.25.0) Release Notes – August 13th, 2025[/url][/u][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]Earlier this week, we opened a survey in partnership with [b]Xbox Research[/b] to solicit player feedback about the [b]in-sim Marketplace[/b]. If you would like to share your opinions about the Marketplace with the development team, you can [u][url="https://survey.alchemer.com/s3/8390093/2d869e71df56"]participate in the survey at this link[/url][/u]. Your feedback is incredibly valuable to us as the team looks to make future improvements to the Marketplace experience. Thank you to all who complete the survey![/p][p]As mentioned in the weekly Development Blog a few weeks ago, [i]Microsoft Flight Simulator[/i] will be at [u][url="https://www.gamescom.global/en"]Gamescom[/url][/u] again this year in Cologne, Germany! If you are attending the event, please stop by our booth and say hello to members of the MSFS team. We always love meeting and chatting with our players and fans![/p][p]To coincide with Gamescom, next week we will be releasing both [b]City Update 12[/b] and [b]Local Legend 21[/b]! We’re excited to share more information about both of these updates with you in the coming days![/p][p]Our efforts to backport selected aircraft from MSFS 2024 to MSFS (2020) continues. This week, three additional planes from MSFS 2024 are now available in the MSFS (2020) Marketplace: the Air Tractor AT-802, Pipistrel Taurus M, and Powrachute Sky Rascal.[/p][p]Last but certainly not least, [b]August 18 is the five-year anniversary of the launch of [i]Microsoft Flight Simulator (2020)[/i] on PC[/b]! To celebrate, we’re asking the community to participate in our 5×5 event: for the fifth anniversary of MSFS, share your top five favorite things from the past year: they can be your best screenshots, your most memorable flights, your top five aircraft, your favorite third party add-on developers, and more! [u][url="https://forums.flightsimulator.com/t/share-your-5x5-celebrating-5-years-of-msfs-2020/732953"]See this forum thread[/url][/u] for more information and to share your personal MSFS 5×5![/p][p][i]– MSFS Team[/i]
[/p][hr][/hr][p][url="https://www.flightsimulator.com/august-14th-2025-development-update/"]Click here to continue reading the Development Update![/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: August 7th, 2025 Development Update
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216946/e5ba1e1a9d551641daeda6ac3a64df14ff0e4b42.jpg"][/img]
On Tuesday, [b]Sim Update 16[/b] for [i]Microsoft Flight Simulator (2020)[/i] saw its full release. This update includes improvements to stability and performance to aircraft, avionics, and more! [u][url="https://www.flightsimulator.com/sim-update-16-msfs-2020/"]Click here to read the full release notes.[/url][/u] We are also carefully monitoring player feedback regarding this update. We encourage all players to [u][url="https://forums.flightsimulator.com/t/polls-microsoft-flight-simulator-2020-sim-update-16-feedback/732413"]vote in our surveys here and leave a comment on our forums[/url][/u] about your experience with SU16.[/p][p]Public beta testing for [i]Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024[/i] [b]Sim Update 3[/b] remains ongoing. Yesterday, we released a new test build to those enrolled in the beta. You can see the release notes here:[/p][list][*][p][u][url="https://forums.flightsimulator.com/t/sim-update-3-beta-1-5-23-0-release-notes-august-6th-2025/732471"]Sim Update 3 Beta (1.5.23.0) Release Notes – August 6th, 2025[/url][/u][/p][/*][/list][p]Also this week, we released the latest monthly navigation data update (AIRAC cycle 2508) to players on all platforms. This update will be installed automatically the next time you launch the sim.[/p][p]Finally, there is currently an airport sale ongoing in both the MSFS (2020) and MSFS 2024 Marketplaces! [u][url="https://www.flightsimulator.com/top-rated-airport-sale-msfs-2020-and-2024/"]See this page[/url][/u] for a list of all the airports that currently have discounted pricing.[/p][p][i]– MSFS Team[/i]

notes.title: July 31st, 2025 Development Update
notes.content:
[p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216946/e4db2a4d235e9d4d47a9fb0a0b32595c8c360d9c.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Public beta testing for [i]Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024[/i] [b]Sim Update 3[/b] and [i]Microsoft Flight Simulator (2020)[/i] [b]Sim Update 16 [/b]continues. Earlier this week, we submitted a new pre-release build for SU3 to volunteer community testers. You can read the release notes below:[/p][list][*][p][u][url="https://forums.flightsimulator.com/t/sim-update-3-beta-1-5-21-0-release-notes-july-30th-2025/731692"]Sim Update 3 Beta (1.5.21.0) Release Notes – July 30th, 2025[/url][/u][/p][/*][/list][p]As part of SU3, the team has been working on improvements to ATC localization for non-English languages. For any non-English speakers participating in the SU3 beta, please complete [u][url="https://forms.office.com/r/YdTU8Xzjkw"]the short survey at this link[/url][/u] to share your feedback about the ATC updates with the development team. Your responses make a huge difference in our improvement efforts![/p][p]Next month some members of the team will be in Cologne, Germany to attend [u][url="https://news.xbox.com/en-us/2025/07/28/xbox-gamescom-2025/"]Gamescom[/url][/u], the largest video game industry show in Europe. [i]Microsoft Flight Simulator[/i] players can look forward to an exciting city update, a brand-new aircraft that many fans will recognize for use in the sim, and exciting and unique challenges for players to test their piloting skills.[/p][p]Just as we did last year, we are once again hosting a small in-person Microsoft Flight Simulator Community event in Cologne, Germany on the evening of [b]August 23rd[/b]. This free event is a causal mixer between fans of MSFS and includes a buffet-style meal, drinks, and is meant for those who are 18+ in age. There is no presentation or exclusive information being presented at this event. You do not need a ticket to Gamescom to attend this event. Anyone wishing to attend can express interest by completing [u][url="https://forms.cloud.microsoft/r/RCUbEjm4Zx"]this web form[/url][/u].[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216946/c85bfe9aac6dfb2af7013abeb392097758a89cc6.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Attendees at last year’s Gamescom MSFS Community event.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][i]– MSFS Team[/i][/p][p]
[/p][p]
[/p][hr][/hr][p][url="https://www.flightsimulator.com/july-31st-2025-development-update/"]Click here to continue reading the Development Update![/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: July 24th, 2025 Development Update
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216946/b1bf14e28c2c1cfec9fdc12d61eae4e881984151.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Yesterday, we hosted our latest [b]Developer Livestream [/b]on [u][url="https://twitch.tv/msfsofficial"]our official Twitch channel[/url][/u]. Our usual panel of Jorg, Seb, and Martial answered many questions from the community about both [i]Microsoft Flight Simulator (2020) [/i]and [i]Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024[/i] and then welcomed Marwan Gharib from FlightFX to demo their newly-released aircraft, the [b]Cessna Citation X[/b], the first in our [u][url="https://www.flightsimulator.com/msfs-presents-flightfx-cessna-citation-x/"]Marketplace Exclusive Series[/url][/u]. If you missed it live, you can watch the replay on YouTube below:[/p][p][u][url="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iA_b1BX60kw"][img src="https://img.youtube.com/vi/iA_b1BX60kw/maxresdefault.jpg"][/img][/url][/u][/p][p]Also this week, we released three new test builds to those participating in the public beta for [i]Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024[/i] [b]Sim Update 3[/b] and [i]Microsoft Flight Simulator (2020)[/i] [b]Sim Update 16[/b]. You can read the release notes  for both below:[/p][list][*][p][u][url="https://forums.flightsimulator.com/t/sim-update-3-beta-1-5-18-0-release-notes-july-18th-2025/730324"]Sim Update 3 Beta (1.5.18.0) Release Notes – July 18th, 2025[/url][/u][/p][/*][*][p][u][url="https://forums.flightsimulator.com/t/sim-update-3-beta-1-5-17-0-release-notes-july-16th-2025/730039"]Sim Update 3 Beta (1.5.19.0) Release Notes – July 23rd, 2025[/url][/u][/p][/*][*][p][u][url="https://forums.flightsimulator.com/t/sim-update-16-beta-1-39-9-0-release-notes-july-22-2025/730814"]Sim Update 16 Beta \[1.39.9.0] Release Notes – July 22nd, 2025[/url][/u][/p][/*][/list][p]The development team has been very closely monitoring the feedback submitted by players in the beta forums and reviewing the telemetry data we receive from testers. Thank you to everyone who has opted in to the beta, shared feedback and bug reports [u][url="https://forums.flightsimulator.com/"]on our forums[/url][/u] and voted in the [u][url="https://forums.flightsimulator.com/c/su3/su3-surveys/391"]SU3[/url][/u] and [u][url="https://forums.flightsimulator.com/c/su16/su16-surveys/434"]SU16[/url][/u] beta player surveys.[/p][p]Finally, you may have noticed that we recently started posting on [u][url="https://bsky.app/"]Bluesky[/url][/u]! You can now keep up with the latest MSFS news on your social platform of choice:[/p][list][*][p][u][url="https://bsky.app/profile/msfsofficial.bsky.social"]Bluesky[/url][/u][/p][/*][*][p][u][url="https://www.facebook.com/MSFSofficial"]Facebook[/url][/u][/p][/*][*][p][u][url="https://www.threads.com/@msfsofficial"]Threads[/url][/u][/p][/*][*][p][u][url="https://x.com/MSFSofficial"]X (formerly Twitter)[/url][/u][/p][/*][/list][p]Additionally, we also post short video content to [u][url="https://www.instagram.com/msfsofficial/?hl=en"]Instagram[/url][/u] and [u][url="https://www.tiktok.com/@msfsofficial?lang=en"]TikTok[/url][/u]. Be sure to follow @msfsofficial on all your preferred social networks![/p][p][i]– MSFS Team[/i][/p][p]

notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216946/54f3ccae7b3c3237eb707044533d7c4c6bd532ff.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Public pre-release testing of both [b]Sim Update 3[/b] for [i]Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024[/i] and [b]Sim Update 16[/b] for [i]Microsoft Flight Simulator (2020)[/i] continues, with both sims receiving a new beta build this week. In case you missed it, you can read the release notes for these new beta builds here:[/p][list][*][p][u][url="https://forums.flightsimulator.com/t/sim-update-3-beta-1-5-15-0-release-notes-july-9th-2025/729049"]Sim Update 3 Beta (1.5.15.0) Release Notes – July 9th, 2025[/url][/u][/p][/*][*][p][u][url="https://forums.flightsimulator.com/t/sim-update-16-beta-1-39-6-0-release-notes-july-8-2025/729004"]Sim Update 16 Beta \[1.39.6.0] Release Notes – July 8, 2025[/url][/u][/p][/*][/list][p]Also new this week, we’re pleased to announce that several aircraft from the Deluxe and Premium Deluxe Editions of Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 are now available to rent from the in-sim Marketplace. Renting gives simmers the opportunity to try these planes for a small fee. When you rent an item, you’ll also receive an offer to purchase it at a discounted price.[/p][p]This offer is valid during your rental period and for seven (7) days after your rental expires. The purchase price is calculated by subtracting the highest single rental price you paid from the current full purchase price of the item in the Marketplace. For example: If the item costs $10 and you rented it twice, once for three days at $3 and once for one day at $1, the discounted purchase price would be $10 (item price) – $3 (highest rental paid) = $7.[/p][p]You can find more information about which Deluxe and Premium Deluxe Edition aircraft are available for rent in the image below:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216946/5afc5d7e8b75ecf8618ad60410873a6153cf4683.png"][/img][/p][p]Finally, we are now accepting questions for our next [b]Developer Livestream [/b]scheduled for [b]July 23, 2025[/b]. If you’d like to pre-submit a question to the panel, [u][url="https://forms.cloud.microsoft/r/r0gkJBqJXy"]you can do so at this link[/url][/u].[/p][p][i]– MSFS Team[/i][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][url="https://www.flightsimulator.com/july-10th-2025-development-update/"]Click here to continue reading the Development Update![/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Microsoft Flight Simulator Releases City Update 11: Northeastern United States 2
notes.content: [p][/p][previewyoutube="hEZSjw5-mLE;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Launched in celebration of FlightSimExpo 2025, held in Providence, Rhode Island in late June, City Update 11: Northeastern United States highlights several areas of interest (AOIs) across four northeastern U.S. states: Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, and Rhode Island. This update comprises a spectacular mix of locations throughout this storied region of the United States, including portions of New England, one of the most important heritage areas in the nation. Microsoft and partners created each AOI using recent high-resolution aerial and satellite imagery, digital elevation models (DEMs), and TIN (triangulated irregular network) surface texturing. City Update 11 invites exploration throughout the sights of this historically renowned part of America, where each flight is filled with expansive vistas and intriguing landmarks.[/p][p]Areas of Interest included, by state: [/p][p][b]Massachusetts[/b][/p][p][u]Boston[/u]: The capital of and most populous city in the state of Massachusetts, Boston serves as the primary cultural, financial, and logistical hub of the New England region. Founded in 1630, Boston is one of the oldest cities in the United States and is one of the most renowned of the country’s heritage sites, notably due to its role in the American Revolution.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216946/1a887c0f5012c377bbdc0bf67b519912200bb580.jpg"][/img][/p][p][u]Plymouth[/u]: The Mayflower Pilgrims landed at Plymouth in 1620, making it one of the most important historical sites in the United States. Called “America’s Hometown,” Plymouth is located 40 miles south of Boston and is the oldest settlement in New England.[/p][p][b]New Jersey[/b][/p][p][u]Northeastern New Jersey[/u]: Cities include Newark, Hackensack, and Paterson, all of which are members of the greater New York metropolitan area. Newark, one of the oldest cities in the United States, is renowned for its contribution to the industrial development of the country and as a modern transportation hub. Hackensack is known for its historical importance during the American Revolution where George Washington established a headquarters. Paterson became a key location in the Industrial Revolution due to the energy supplied by the Great Falls of the Passaic River, around which the city was initially constructed.[/p][p][u]Central Jersey[/u]: This AOI focuses on cities in the eastern portion of Central Jersey, including Elizabeth, New Brunswick, and Edison. Elizabeth was the first capital of New Jersey and is one of the state’s oldest cities. New Brunswick played an important role in the American Revolution and is an important university center. Edison (originally called Raritan Township) was named after famed American inventor Thomas Edison who established his research laboratory in the area and created several important innovations, including the incandescent light bulb and the phonograph.[/p][p][b]New York[/b][/p][p][u]Brooklyn[/u]: Located on the western end of Long Island, Brooklyn is the most populous of the five boroughs of New York City. It lies just south of the borough of Queens and is connected to the borough of Manhattan by one tunnel and three bridges that span the East River. Brooklyn offers some of the most stunning views in all of New York City, notably of the Brooklyn Bridge, the East River, and lower Manhattan.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216946/0e31b5963fecbfcbe2f54419e760af57e897a3c6.jpg"][/img][/p][p][u]Manhattan[/u]: Manhattan is one of the most renowned urban centers in the world. The smallest borough by area of the five boroughs that compose New York City, Manhattan is often cited as the capital of several global industries, including finance, media, and entertainment. Known for its iconic architecture, Manhattan is home to the tallest building in both the United States and the Western Hemisphere, One World Trade Center (1,776 feet tall), and the second tallest in the Nation and the Western Hemisphere, Central Park Tower (1,550 feet tall).[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216946/868432f997b1a24d6fd1e4874a46087da383a9da.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][u]Long Island’s East End[/u]: One of the most beautiful areas in the northeastern United States, Long Island’s East End is renowned for its pastoral landscapes, historic villages, colonial architecture, and maritime vistas. The update includes Southampton, one of the core towns of the well-known Hamptons resort area, and Montauk, the easternmost point in New York State and home to the spectacular Montauk Point Lighthouse.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216946/94f8500158ea990c60e1dff55d3b897ca4f823d0.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Rhode Island[/b][/p][p]The update’s Rhode Island AOI covers all major cities in the state, including Providence, Cranston, and Warwick. Providence, established in 1636, is the capital and most populous city in the state. Providence, along with the cities of Cranston and Warwick to its south, are located along the mouth of the Providence River at the northern extremity of Narragansett Bay, which opens to the Atlantic Ocean.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216946/6bdca744679c3425b7a8e53d3520c1f0047ccf9e.jpg"][/img][/p][p]City Update 11: Northeastern United States is available FREE to all owners of Microsoft Flight Simulator. Ensure that you have the latest simulator version installed (1.38.2.0 for MSFS2020 / 1.3.23.0 for MSFS2024 / 1.3.25.0 for MSFS2024 on Windows PC - Steam as of 06/27/2025), download City Update 11, and take to the skies above the Northeastern United States![/p][p][i]Microsoft Flight Simulator is available for Xbox Series X|S and PC with Xbox Game Pass, PC Game Pass, Windows, and Steam, and on Xbox One and supported mobile phones, tablets, and lower-spec PCs via Xbox Cloud Gaming. For the latest information on[url="https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/microsoft-flight-simulator"] Microsoft Flight Simulator[/url], stay tuned to[url="https://nam06.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Ftwitter.com%2Fmsfsofficial&data=04%7C01%7Csdamron%40microsoft.com%7Cf8bc9c21123c4a96cdad08d9638933b8%7C72f988bf86f141af91ab2d7cd011db47%7C1%7C0%7C637650263260978930%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJWIjoiMC4wLjAwMDAiLCJQIjoiV2luMzIiLCJBTiI6Ik1haWwiLCJXVCI6Mn0%3D%7C1000&sdata=JGnMisKNWgsAXVJ1sXZrD7xHUpe9RSqILuA7B2ochk0%3D&reserved=0"] @MSFSOfficial[/url] on Twitter.[/i] [/p][p] [/p]

notes.title: June 26th, 2025 Development Update
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216946/01dda8708dbc084deaac349a3937e609841e7803.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Over the past week, we released three new pre-release test builds, two for [i][b]Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 [/b][/i][b]Sim Update 3 [/b]and one for [i][b]Microsoft Flight Simulator (2020) Sim Update 16[/b][/i][b]. [/b]You can read the release notes for these builds linked below:[/p][list][*][p][url="https://forums.flightsimulator.com/t/sim-update-3-beta-1-5-9-0-release-notes-june-20th-2025/726801"][u]MSFS 2024 SU3 Beta Build 1.5.9.0[/u][/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://forums.flightsimulator.com/t/sim-update-3-beta-1-5-10-0-release-notes-june-25th-2025/727518"][u]MSFS 2024 SU3 Beta Build 1.5.10.0[/u][/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://forums.flightsimulator.com/t/sim-update-16-beta-1-39-5-0-release-notes-june-23rd-2025/727286"][u]MSFS (2020) SU16 Beta Build 1.39.5.0[/u][/url][/p][/*][/list][p]We are very closely monitoring reports from community testers about an increase in crashes to desktop (CTDs) in SU3 beta build 1.5.10.0. Based on player feedback thus far, these crashes appear to be related to using third-party mods which use the SimConnect API. To assist the development team in troubleshooting and resolving this issue, we encourage SU3 beta testers to post their findings about which mods/add-ons seem to cause the CTD [url="https://forums.flightsimulator.com/t/ctd-loading-into-1-5-10-0/727551"][u]in this forum thread[/u][/url].[/p][p]Yesterday on [url="https://twitch.tv/msfsofficial"][u]our official Twitch channel[/u][/url], we hosted a technical expert from Pimax to answer your VR questions plus several popular VR YouTubers ([url="https://www.youtube.com/@tallymouse"][u]Tally Mouse[/u][/url], [url="https://www.youtube.com/@VRFlightSimGuy"][u]VR Flight Sim Guy[/u][/url], [url="https://www.youtube.com/@theVRpilot"][u]theVRpilot[/u][/url], and [url="https://www.youtube.com/@SkyraiderOpsOnline"][u]Skyraider79er[/u][/url], a real-world Airbus A320 captain) to demonstrate flying [i]Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024[/i] in VR mode! If you missed the session live, you can re-watch the VOD [url="https://www.twitch.tv/videos/2496458960"][u]at this link[/u][/url].[/p][p]As a final reminder, Pimax is currently offering a 5% discount on the purchase of a Pimax Crystal Light or Crystal Super VR headset if you use code [b]MSFS[/b] at checkout from the [url="https://pimax.com/pages/store"][u]Pimax Store[/u][/url]. Additionally, one lucky winner will be randomly selected to receive a 100% refund on their order! If you’re considering trying MSFS in VR or if you’re an existing VR pilot looking to upgrade your hardware, take advantage of this offer between now and Friday, June 27![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216946/bd84fcb691d2dba3735411bf0198f2cc88dfaf5a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Last but certainly not least, we’d like to wish [b]safe travels[/b] to everyone from the community attending [url="https://flightsimexpo.com/"][u]FlightSimExpo 2025[/u][/url] this weekend! Enjoy a fantastic few days of making new friends with fellow MSFS enthusiasts, trying the latest hardware peripherals and software add-ons from various different vendors, attending many interesting talks and lectures from guest speakers, and taking in the sights of Providence, Rhode Island![/p][p][/p][p][i]– MSFS Team[/i][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][url="https://www.flightsimulator.com/june-26th-2025-development-update/"]Click here to continue reading the Development Update![/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216946/4d306a3bdf50fc394a12c1d9263912e664c1e525.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Over the past week, we released four new pre-release test builds, two each for [i][b]Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 [/b][/i][b]Sim Update 3 [/b]and [i][b]Microsoft Flight Simulator (2020) Sim Update 16[/b][/i][b]. [/b]You can read the release notes for these builds linked below:[/p][list][*][p][url="https://forums.flightsimulator.com/t/sim-update-3-beta-1-5-8-0-release-notes-june-18th-2025/726580"][u]MSFS 2024 SU3 Beta Build 1.5.7.0[/u][/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://forums.flightsimulator.com/t/sim-update-3-beta-1-5-7-0-release-notes-june-13th-2025/724786"][u]MSFS 2024 SU3 Beta Build 1.5.8.0[/u][/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://forums.flightsimulator.com/t/sim-update-16-beta-1-39-3-0-release-notes-june-17th-2025/726457/1"][u]MSFS (2020) SU16 Beta Build 1.39.3.0[/u][/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://forums.flightsimulator.com/t/sim-update-16-beta-1-39-4-0-release-notes-june-19th-2025/726699/1"][u]MSFS (2020) SU16 Beta Build 1.39.4.0[/u][/url][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Calling non-English speakers![/b] We are currently looking for experts in the following languages to assist in improving the translation of air traffic control radio transmissions.[/p][list][*][p]Chinese (Simplified)[/p][/*][*][p]Dutch[/p][/*][*][p]Finnish[/p][/*][*][p]Italian[/p][/*][*][p]Japanese[/p][/*][*][p]Korean[/p][/*][*][p]Norwegian (Bokmål)[/p][/*][*][p]Polish[/p][/*][*][p]Portuguese (Portugal)[/p][/*][*][p]Russian[/p][/*][*][p]Spanish (Mexico)[/p][/*][*][p]Spanish (Spain)[/p][/*][*][p]Swedish[/p][/*][*][p]Turkish[/p][/*][/list][p]If you are an expert at any of the above languages and would like to improve the localization of [i]Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024[/i] in your language, please complete [url="https://forms.microsoft.com/r/2DuH7CJbKt"][u]this web form[/u][/url]. We greatly value the community’s assistance![/p][p]Finally, we are thrilled to announce a special promotion and educational livestream held in conjunction with Pimax, a cutting-edge VR headset maker! Until June 26, purchase either a Pimax Crystal Light or Crystal Super using code [b]MSFS[/b] to receive a 5% discount on your order. Additionally, one random winner will receive a [b]FULL REBATE[/b] on their purchase price! Head over to the [url="https://pimax.com/pages/store"][u]Pimax web store[/u][/url] to enjoy the 5% discount and your chance to win a Pimax VR headset for free![/p][p]Finally, on our official Twitch channel on Wednesday, June 26 starting at 11am PT (1800 UTC) we will be welcoming technical expert from Pimax to answer your VR questions. Additional special guests will include VR YouTubers [url="https://www.youtube.com/@tallymouse"][u]Tally Mouse[/u][/url], [url="https://www.youtube.com/@VRFlightSimGuy"][u]VR Flight Sim Guy[/u][/url], [url="https://www.youtube.com/@theVRpilot"][u]theVRpilot[/u][/url], and real-world Airbus A320 captain Marlon Choyce, all of whom will be demonstrating how to enhance your sense of immersion and realism using virtual reality for the ultimate flight simulation experience![/p][p][/p][p][i]– MSFS Team[/i][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][url="https://www.flightsimulator.com/june-12th-2025-development-update/"]Click here to continue reading the Development Update![/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: June 12th, 2025 Development Update
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216946/ac86674bb47b9f457b7a6f1d867159ac028c4f1c.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Today we’re pleased to premiere the latest entry in our Partnership Series of videos! This time, we’re thrilled to highlight Heart Aerospace and their hybrid-electric ES-30 airplane. Capable of flying with zero CO2 emissions on routes up to 200 km and with significantly reduced emissions compared to conventional aircraft on routes up to 800 km, the ES-30 is poised to help usher in a new era of environmentally-sustainable aviation. [i]If you are playing on PC, outdated packages in your community folder may have an unexpected impact on the title’s performance and behavior.[/i]

[h1][b]Windows PC/Steam[/b][/h1]
NVIDIA has released their latest GeForce Game Ready Driver (576.28), and we recommend all NVIDIA GPU owners update to the latest driver version. More recent NVIDIA driver versions resolve certain crashes with Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 and improve performance and stability. More details available at: [url=https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/drivers/details/245376/]https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/drivers/details/245376/[/url]

[hr][/hr]
[h1] [b]New Content and Features[/b][/h1]
[list]
 	[*]Dumps Console logs when reporting an issue[/*]
 	[*]Renamed "Gyro drift" to "Gyro drift compensation" to be more in line with other assistance (ON: Less realistic, OFF: More realistic)[/*]
 	[*]Readded turbulence assistance[/*]
 	[*]Added a Wake Turbulence Visualization option[/*]
 	[*]Added a Wake Turbulence assistance[/*]
 	[*]It is now possible to filter seaplane base airports using the World Map filters[/*]
 	[*]A new validation process has been developed to give more information and control to aircraft developers over the Career compatibility.A new field has been added in the FLTSIM section "targeted_specializations" (supported by the SimObjectEditor) to list the expected specialization with which the given aircraft should be compatible.[/*]
 	[*]During the ingestion process, the field will be compared to the result of the career compatibility process to confirm its result.[/*]
 	[*]A new field has been added in the FLTSIM section "targeted_specializations" (supported by the SimObjectEditor) to list the expected specialization with which the given aircraft should be compatible. During the ingestion process, the field will be compared to the result of the career compatibility process to confirm its result. THIS FIELD MUST BE FILLED TO BE COMPATIBLE WITH CAREER[/*]
[/list]

[hr][/hr]
[h1] [b]Stability & Performance[/b][/h1]
[list]
 	[*]Added option to reduce rolling cache size, at the cost of clearing current cache.[/*]
 	[*]Improved loading times for packages with lots of individual files[/*]
 	[*]Fixed an issue where rapidly switching between tabs in the settings menu could lead to unexpected behavior and performance issues.[/*]
 	[*]Reduced request count when loading models by precomputing model statistics on package ingestion.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed a rare crash when internet connection was lost.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed a crash when suspending the sim on Xbox.[/*]
 	[*]Improved the time it takes to open the in game panels[/*]
 	[*]Fixed a crash when changing DLSS quality mode during VR.[/*]
 	[*]Reduced performance hit when avatar is near objects with complex collisions[/*]
 	[*]Fixed crash when many avatars meet up online[/*]
 	[*]Fixed a potential infinite loading when importing config files[/*]
 	[*]Fixed a rare crash caused by live traffic[/*]
 	[*]Improved rolling cache usage.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed crashes inside GPU drivers due to off-by-one error inside our texture loading code.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed double focus issue is UI Lists[/*]
 	[*]Fixed Aircraft Selector showing an empty tile when opened[/*]
 	[*]Added more information to debug FPS panel (available VRAM on device, lat/long/alt, GPU) to make it easier to diagnose issues reported by users sharing screenshots in forums[/*]
 	[*]Fixed crash when trying to remove a FacilityAirport from the cache while the QMID has no matching entry[/*]
 	[*]Fixed some infinite loadings on boot due to deadlocks inside IO code.

notes.title: Microsoft Flight Simulator Releases City Update 10: United States I
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=sa9C-zhT2DE;full][/previewyoutube]

This release spotlights a diverse selection of the country’s most beautiful locations, from Dallas, Texas to Honolulu, Hawaii.

[i]Microsoft Flight Simulator City Update 10: United States I delivers five spectacular cities throughout the United States in vibrant detail: Dallas and Fort Worth, Texas; Denver, Colorado; San Francisco, California; and Honolulu, Hawaii. Each city has been crafted using the latest aerial and satellite imagery, digital elevation models (DEMs), and TIN (triangulated irregular network) surface texturing. The exquisite detail offered in this latest release will inspire aviators to explore these storied cities and admire their landmarks throughout every season, at any time of the day or night.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216946/a5caf5c46e62346c6a21fc016f00e8ad5e1d9982.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]Dallas and Fort Worth, Texas[/b][/h3]
Dallas, and its sister city to the west, Fort Worth, were established in the 1800s as railroad hubs to serve the cotton, livestock, and oil industries of Texas. Today, the Dallas-Fort Worth Metroplex, a key urban anchor in north Texas, is the most populous metropolitan area in the state. The region is a major international hub of several industries, including manufacturing, defense, finance, and tourism. The metroplex offers spectacular sights, including the iconic Fountain Place and a 720-foot-tall modernist skyscraper in Dallas; 777 Main Street in Fort Worth, a striking building that stands 525 feet tall; and the 561-foot-tall Reunion Tower, one of the most recognizable buildings in Dallas.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216946/acad49ebe2fbec98b367764e564e649f266b42d0.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]Denver, Colorado[/b][/h3]
Known as the “Mile High City” (its official elevation is 5,280 feet, exactly one mile above sea level), Denver is both the most populous city in Colorado and the state’s capital. Established in 1858 by prospectors who led what would come to be known as the Pike’s Peak gold rush, Denver became an important railroad city in 1870. It blossomed into a major metropolitan center in the 20th century, characterized by a stunning skyline set against the high Rocky Mountains. Some of the sights for pilots to behold include Republic Plaza, the city’s highest building at 714 feet; 1144 Fifteenth, one of the world’s most spectacular modern skyscrapers; the Rocky Mountains to its west; and the vast, oceanic plains east of Denver.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216946/1e3d28b5bab7f87cc7d62ef6859a4d32034181ba.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]San Francisco, California[/b][/h3]
Called by many the most beautiful city in the world, San Francisco is squarely located where the San Francisco Bay opens to the Pacific Ocean. The city was formally established in 1850 due to the boom in population from the California Gold Rush, which began in 1848. Set along a spectacular section of Pacific Ocean coastline, San Francisco offers a wonderful selection of sights, including the world-renowned Golden Gate Bridge; the iconic Transamerica Building; Alcatraz Island; and the San Francisco-Oakland Bay Bridge.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216946/16add76c41048b78d85d55310295981a7b13e650.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]Honolulu, Hawaii[/b][/h3]
The capital and most populous city of the state of Hawaii, Honolulu is known for its beautiful architecture set against the tropical blue and green waters of the Pacific Ocean. Located on the southeastern coast of the island of Oahu, Honolulu boasts human history that dates back many centuries and was incorporated as a city in 1907. Meaning “sheltered port” in Hawaiian, Honolulu features numerous sights for the aerial visitor, including its spectacular skyline; Diamond Head, an extinct volcanic cone just to the southeast of the city; the waters of the Pacific Ocean; and the spectacular Koʻolau Range inland of the metropolitan area.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216946/13da40b7fab1a955259537c34b30f2a758c743ec.jpg[/img]

City Update 10: United States I is available FREE to all owners of [i]Microsoft Flight Simulator [/i]and[i] Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024[/i]. Ensure that you have the latest simulator version installed, download City Update 10, and explore. The sky is calling!

For the latest information on Microsoft Flight Simulator products, stay tuned to [u][url=https://twitter.com/MSFSofficial]@MSFSOfficial[/url][/u] on X (formerly Twitter) or visit [u][url=http://www.flightsimulator.com/]www.flightsimulator.com[/url][/u].

notes.title: Sim Update 2 Beta Now Available to Join
notes.content:
[b]Are you interested in joining the Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 Sim Update 2 public beta test?[/b]

The Sim Update 02 Beta is now available on Steam, Windows PC, and Xbox. [url=https://forums.flightsimulator.com/t/sim-update-2-beta-1-4-7-0-release-notes-march-25-2025/712825]Click here[/url] to read the release notes and use the [url=https://forums.flightsimulator.com/c/su-msfs2024/370]Sim Update 2 Beta Forums[/url] to report your feedback.

Please find instructions to join the Sim Update 02 Beta below. You must own Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 (or have an appropriate Xbox Game Pass subscription) to participate on the platform of your choice.

[h1]WHAT TO KNOW BEFORE YOU JOIN[/h1]

Please remember if you decide to join the Beta and install the build, you will likely have to re-install your sim if you wish to leave the Beta before it ends. If you did not opt out of the last Beta, you will automatically stay in this Beta and receive the next build.

In addition, while in Multiplayer Mode, you will only see users who are in the same build as you.

[b]Memory Logging in the Sim Update 2 Beta[/b]

Memory logging will be enabled in the first Sim Update 2 Beta build, which will cause a small decrease to performance (in particular during menu transitions). The telemetry we receive from this memory logging will aid our investigations into stability improvements. This memory logging will be removed from the Sim Update 2 Beta before release, or as soon as we have enough data.

On Xbox console, you can help ensure we receive your data by following the below instructions:

Navigate to Settings > System.
Now select Console info.
Check ‘Allow optional data collection’

[b]Changes to Career/Challenge League in the Sim Update 2 Beta[/b]

Beginning with the Sim Update 2 Beta, Career and Challenge League will have separate progress and leaderboards from the live build.

This means Career mode progress in the live build will not carry over to the flighting build, and vice versa. In addition, Challenge League in the flighting build will have a separate leaderboard from the live build.

Making Career and Challenge League progress separate in the flighting build allows us to test additional changes and fixes that cannot be tested in the live build. All Career specializations will be unlocked by default in the flighting build to allow participants to preview changes that might not be available (based on Career mode progress) in the live build.

[h1]STEAM[/h1]
1.	Open your Steam Library
2.	Right-click Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024
3.	Click “Properties”
4.	Click “Betas”
5.	Select “flight_sim_2024_beta – Sim Update 2"

If you would like to exit the pre-release test before it ends and revert back to the live build, follow these instructions:
1.	Open your Steam Library
2.	Right-click Microsoft Flight Simulator
3.	Click “Properties”
4.	Click “Betas”
5.	Select “None”

Thank you and we look forward to your feedback!

notes.title: Sim Update 1 Release Notes [1.3.23] - Available Now
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216946/b3c18192d99bc41723686e10785dd34daef97e88.png[/img]

If you are playing on PC, outdated packages in your community folder may have an unexpected impact on the title’s performance and behavior.

If you suffer from stability issues or long loading times, move your community package(s) to another folder before relaunching the title.

[h1]Marketplace[/h1]
Many of you are eagerly anticipating the inclusion of the Marketplace. We are excited to share that the Marketplace is coming shortly, as we are making final tweaks to ensure it meets everyone’s expectations.

[h1]Stability & Performance[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed rare crash during airport generation
[*] Fixed crash when selecting livery after reloading the game while not flying the default variation
[*] Fixed crash when using ‘Skip to’ feature at beginning of exam.
[*] Fixed potential crash when switching ON/OFF the VR mode during a flight
[*] Renamed “Bandwidth” to “Download” in DisplayFPS panel to avoid misinterpretation by the community
[*] Optimized texture memory usage of WASM gauges
[*] Fixed crash when closing the game during package mounting.
[*] Fixed crash when many avatars meet up online
[*] Fixed crash on Xbox that would occur when accessing areas close to the antemeridian, such as the Savusavu Airport (NFNS) for instance
[*] Improved loading times for packages with lots of individual files
[*] General Bug Fixes
[*] Fixed an issue where the controller was losing inputs if the user went into the filters advanced map layers leaves the sub menu then go back in it
[*] Fixed an issue where going to the world map filters layers would sometimes soft lock the user when going to another page
[*] Fixed community packages preventing streamed packages with the same name from being found by the sim.
[*] Fixed wrong HUD color (purple/white instead of green) on some aircraft
[*] Fixed scene flickering on Xbox sometimes when memory usage is high
[*] Added profanity check on Callsign and FlightNumber in aircraft configurator
[*] Fixed a bug where non selectable aircraft were not taken into consideration by various system after a mount/unmount or after a Build Package
[*] Fixed an issue where going into a showcase “Fixed camera” in the camera panel would cause the camera to go in the cockpit view when reopening the same panel
[*] Fixed multiplayer nameplate display range to low
[*] Fixed UI render issue of items outside of their frame
[*] Fixed Deluxe/Premium/Aviator content not being streamed when booting the game for the first time
[*] The camera panel no longer forces the cockpit view when opened
[*] Fixed swapped colors between Offline and Online friends
[*] Fixed missing music on legacy Discovery flight Activities
[*] Fixed CLOCK_HOURS/MINUTES_INC/DEC events not behaving as expected
[*] Fixed several time-related issues such as ZULU/CLOCK SET events not behaving as expected
[*] Fixed usage of real time instead of flight time when initializing switches (fixes light issues when starting a flight with a sim time that is different from the real time)
[*] Fixed community packages being duplicated inside content.xml on each boot. Already existing duplicates are removed from file on boot.
[*] Increased screen exposure under heavy cloud cover
[/list]

[h1]Backwards Compatibility Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed FS2020 planes exterior lights bleeding into cockpit when displayed in FS2024
[*] Fixed wrong font selected when rendering XML Gauge elements
[*] Forced 2024 SimVar AMBIENT LIGHT SENSOR to return a very high value if requested from a 2020 sim (can happen if referencing an instrument that has been updated in 2024)
[*] Fixed textures referenced in FX files not properly loaded when the package is streamed
[*] Fixed emissives brightness
[/list]

notes.title: Sim Update 1 Beta Now Available to Join
notes.content:
Welcome to the Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 Sim Update 1 public beta test!

The first Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 Beta previewing Sim Update 1 is now available on PC-MS Store, PC-Steam, and Xbox Series X|S.

For those familiar with the previous Microsoft Flight Simulator (2020) public tests, the process to join/leave the Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 Beta is the same and instructions have been provided below. You must own Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 (or have an appropriate Xbox Game Pass subscription) to participate on the platform of your choice.

Please note the in-sim Marketplace is planned to release with Sim Update 1 but will not be accessible during the Beta. You will still be able to access your available owned content via My Library and utilize the same functionality currently present in the sim.

[h1]WHAT TO KNOW BEFORE YOU JOIN[/h1]

Please remember if you decide to join the Beta and install the build, you will likely have to re-install your sim if you wish to leave the Beta before it ends. If you did not opt out of the last Beta, you will automatically stay in this Beta and receive the next build.

In addition, while in Multiplayer Mode, you will only see users who are in the same build as you.

[h1]STEAM[/h1]
1.	Open your Steam Library
2.	Right-click Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024
3.	Click “Properties”
4.	Click “Betas”
5.	Select “flight_sim_2024_beta – Sim Update 1"

If you would like to exit the pre-release test before it ends and revert back to the live build, follow these instructions:
1.	Open your Steam Library
2.	Right-click Microsoft Flight Simulator
3.	Click “Properties”
4.	Click “Betas”
5.	Select “None”

Thank you and we look forward to your feedback!

notes.title: January 9th, 2025 Development Update
notes.content:
After a break for the holiday season to recharge, refresh, and spend time with our families, we're back this week and hard at work updating Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024!

As we begin the new year, our teams are focused on delivering the first major updates, including Sim Update 1, while also finalizing preparations for the Marketplace launch in Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024. We have analyzed all the feedback provided over the past weeks and months and are prioritizing bug fixes and improvements based on community input. Because of this, we are spending this week to working on the Feedback Snapshot and will have an updated version for you in next week's blog. We are also excited to announce that World Update: Brazil is on the horizon! These updates are coming soon, and we will provide more information on the timeline as it becomes available. We appreciate your support as we continue to enhance the simming experience for our community.

On Tuesday, we released [url=https://forums.flightsimulator.com/t/2025-01-07-career-mode-server-side-update/695558]a server-side fix[/url] for an issue that was preventing certain Career Mode mission types from appearing. These missions should now once again be available. Earlier today, we released [url=https://www.flightsimulator.com/release-notes-1-2-11-0-hotfix-available-now-msfs-2024/]a small hotfix patch (1.2.11.0)[/url] to resolve an issue that was causing avionics in some aircraft to be non-functional on Xbox and for PC players using Low or Medium graphics settings.

We are currently planning our next Developer Livestream. While we're still coordinating the schedules of our panel members and guests and don't have a date locked in yet, [url=https://forms.microsoft.com/pages/responsepage.aspx?id=v4j5cvGGr0GRqy180BHbR1r3nNQ_40JBjVeCHjmDms9UMFdKSEhBUkk3RUtSNUdPTUZQWTVBUzI4Ni4u&route=shorturl]we have activated the web form[/url] where you can pre-submit a question. As always, you can watch the livestream on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/msfsofficial]our official Twitch channel[/url], so be sure to follow it and enable notifications so you're informed whenever the broadcast starts.

- MSFS Team

notes.title: Release Notes - [1.2.7.0] Available Now
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216946/b3c18192d99bc41723686e10785dd34daef97e88.png[/img]

Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 update 1.2.7.0 includes the ability to enable/disable Marketplace 2020 ported content on a per-item basis. To ensure that you have full control over your own library, available non-Microsoft ported content is disabled by default so you can choose what to have active in the simulator.

After taking update 1.2.7.0, aircraft that was previously available to select will need to be enabled in My Library to become visible again. More Marketplace 2020 ported content will be made available soon.

Note: Initial loading into Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 on Xbox Series X | S may take longer than normal due to the deactivating of Marketplace 2020 ported content.

If you are playing on PC, outdated packages in your Community Folder may have an unexpected impact on the title’s performance and behavior.

If you suffer from stability issues or long loading times, move your community package(s) to another folder before relaunching the title.

[h1]STABILITY & PERFORMANCE[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed a crash in audio system occurring sometimes when closing the sim
[*] Fixed a crash in the FX system
[*] Fixed a crash that could occur when releasing a lever interaction
[*] Fixed a crash at the end of scientific research missions
[*] Reduced memory usage for aircraft gauge textures generated by WASM (reduces amount of out-of-memory crashes on Xbox with WASM-enabled aircraft)
[*] Fixed a crash which could occur when creating a flight plan in certain airports
[*] Reduced latency with HTTP requests
[*] Fixed a potential crash when using the EFB
[*] Fixed a crash when going to the hardware settings of Tobii Eye Tracker device
[*] Added a popup to propose launching the sim in Safe Mode in case the title crashed during the previous launch
[*] Packages from the Community folder, Marketplace, and from MSFS (2020) carry over process are disabled in Safe Mode to allow the sim to boot
[*] The disabled packages can then be re-enabled manually in My Library
[*] Fixed a crash on machines with more than 32 logical cores
[*] Fixed a crash on Xbox in photo mode
[*] Fixed various other crashes
[*] Limited the number of passengers inside the plane on Low Settings to limit out-of-memory issues on Xbox Series S
[*] Added an integrity check on StreamedPackages folder to detect when files are corrupted.
[*] Changed the CoherentGT frame distribution system and views refresh rate to better match MSFS (2020) behavior
[*] Reduced the stutter of the game when the panel camera is opened
[*] Optimized boot time
[*] Fixed low power mode activating when watching the credits screen
[/list]

[h1]GENERAL BUG FIXES[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed virtual keyboard menu opening twice when backing out of group chat textbox on Xbox
[*] Fixed windshield effects (backwards compatibility)
[*] Fixed a camera bug when using the EFB checklist “look at” buttons while being in the menu
[*] Fixed multiple fade outs when going in/out of aircraft with other players around
[*] Fixed grey haze at night in very dark environments
[*] Improved normal textures from MSFS (2020) packages, making them look less flat
[*] Fixed loading of DDS files used in legacy effects
[*] Fixed some flow locks when missions restart
[*] Fixed debug text being displayed on controls screen on first boot
[*] Fixed an issue where some gamepad icons were present in the photo mode even when using a keyboard
[*] No modular aircraft (or common part of a modular aircraft) can now have preflight pins
[*] Fixed generic version of standalone WASM modules trying to be read creating “standalone_generic.wasm failed to access memory” error message
[*] Props, turbines, and rotors now move on first-party multiplayer aircraft
[*] Fixed toolbar not being usable in cursor mode while in external view
[*] Fixed NVIDIA DLSS anti-aliasing noise
[*] Improved download throttling when a bandwidth limit is set
[*] Reduced objects popping
[*] Fixed PartInfo CustomSimvars (Z:) and LocalVars (L:1)
[*] Fixed mismatched Xbox and PC assistance XML causing G-Effect assist to be off on console
[*] Fixed missions not showing properly in “Custom Content”
[*] Fixed Custom Content list not spawning in the right place
[*] Fixed Custom Content list text displaying on top of scroll mask
[*] Fixed numbers not displaying correctly with some system formats
[*] Fixed the scrollbar appearing for a frame when it was not needed before the size of the content was received
[*] Changed initial trim in Free Flight for MSFS (2020) aircraft - now set back to neutral as was the case in MSFS (2020)
[*] Fixed integers division in RPN expressions
[*] Fixed look around step when starting some mission with the mouse
[*] Added new global var (P:IS CAMERA LOCKED, Bool) to know if the current camera is locked
[*] Fixed flow being stuck when entering options, market or settings from help page
[*] Fixed localization bugs
[*] Fixed intensity of runway lights
[*] Fixed gliders spawning as passive aircraft
[*] Fixed long boot times when client time does not match server time
[*] Fixed Morse sounds being too loud
[*] Fixed input when running as avatar
[*] Fixed most detected buildings spawning on parking spots
[*] Fixed drone camera speed being FPS dependent when it shouldn’t be
[*] BACKWARDS COMPATIBILITY BUG FIXES
[*] Fixed Wwise 2019 modulators back-compatibility issue
[*] The content of the “html_ui” folder is no longer encrypted
[*] Fixed handling of SimObjects with wrong ATC parking codes (longer than 4 characters)
[*] Fixed node attachment issue when changing LOD on a model attachment
[*] Fixed scenery VFX objects not spawning their effect
[/list]

notes.title: Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 Launch Day Update
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=kuMd7udCyFM;full][/previewyoutube]

We have worked hard with our partners, including Asobo and others, to bring you an amazing sim experience. The excitement for the sim today has been overwhelming, but we encountered an issue with one of our services handling the new systems in the game like career mode and various missions. The server responsible for handling data requests got overloaded, causing delays and errors.

As a result, players are experiencing long loading times and missing content like aircraft. We have solved the issues and are now bringing players in at a steady pace. We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your patience. We will keep you updated on our social channels, forums, and website. Thank you very much for all your feedback and support.
